edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender to _transfer inside transfer.
enableRewards authorizes the caller via msg.sender compared to _taxWallet.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the deadline for addLiquidityETH in addLiquidity.
_taxFee feeds the mul/div tax computation in _tokenTransfer.
_taxWallet is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
_maxTxAmount is read to enforce the transaction amount limit in _transfer.
_balance mapping is mutated in _tokenTransfer.
_pair address is the target of the low-level call and its balance is manipulated in enableRewards.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external call susceptible to reentrancy.
_transfer sends ETH to the fee wallet when the contract balance threshold is met.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer for the actual balance update.
enableRewards performs the low-level call to the pair, which can reenter.
enableRewards calls swapTokensForEth when the low-level call succeeds.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance without access control.
manualSend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance without access control.
swapTokensForEth executes the external Uniswap swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfer to the tax wallet.
addLiquidity executes the external Uniswap addLiquidityETH call.
createUniswapPair assigns the returned pair address to _pair.
increaseMaxTx writes the new value into _maxTxAmount.
increaseMaxWallet writes the new value into _maxWallet.
The low-level call to the pair can invoke back into enableRewards state before completion.
The external Uniswap swap can call back into _transfer while the contract state is mid-update.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a parameter flowing into the internal _transfer function.
amount is only a parameter flowing into the internal _transfer function.
sender is only a parameter scoped to the transferFrom function.
tokenAmount is only a parameter used inside the swapTokensForEth function.
contractTokenBalance is a local computed in _transfer and consumed by swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a local in _transfer gating the call to sendETHToFee.
